name: okey-dokey-mobile
description: Okey Dokey 安卓端 / Android build — 大模型 API 密钥保险库

scripts.sync: npm run build:www && cap sync android
scripts.apk:debug: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.apk:release: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
scripts.bundle:release: npm run sync && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
